configurationSource: Assets/Scenes/Park*.unity, loaded by Unity; missing serialized fields use current runtime defaults
handPolicy: All production magic uses TabletopHandSample + TabletopGestureRules + GestureReachWindow. Right hand: A pinch-release, B point-circle, C horizontal palm swipe, D fist-open. UI/Fit/Plane capture cancels casting; release required after interruption.
lighterPolicy: Lighter and all six Park profiles share classification thresholds. Different targets dispatch different effects. Synthetic editor checks do not validate YOLO or PICO.
